$doc: §23.6 ST-5. Merge (§16b, D-P7): out of the band + margin and quiet for the quiet time (and UNOBSERVED); then BusResolutionSwitch.Merge sums each child back (X-4) - a slot with no child is down. The margin is raised to 250 m by the author's policy so the merge lies beyond the split trigger (with the default 100 m it does not: finding F-23). The second split is the instructor's pin, a do-set of AggregateUnit.Pin = PinPhysical (SV-14). Children by network id (F-22, R-8335). ⚠ Measured: at the end only 20-22 slots read exactly 25 - a few whole men come back slightly hurt (>= 13 of 25) from their time as soldiers; the source is not traced (the patrol walks away beyond rifle reach), so the rows judge the losses (3 down, never a 4th, 27 up, the 2 hurt still hurt), not exact health.

expect.name: contact: the platoon splits (the patrol 450 m off)
contact ends (the patrol walks away past the band + margin, 650 m, and 20 s pass): the men merge back
the merge kept every loss (the table at the end is the merged one - a split never writes it): the 3 dead slots are down
... never a 4th (no man lost or invented by the round trip)
... and the 2 hurt men come back hurt (health 12.5 of 25)
... and 27 men up: none lost, none invented by the round trip
... never 28 up (a dead man is never re-created)
the instructor pins it Physical (t = 250 s): it splits AGAIN at once
no second split before the pin: the merge lies past the split trigger (the author's 250 m margin)
